value.rationale: Edge insertion usually improves conductance, but its effect on a physically natural stationary avalanche first moment can be opposite. The all-chord i+j=n boundary classifies both signs over an infinite natural network family, while an edge incident to the injection site has a sharp asymptotic factor-two increase. This is an interpretable structural transport phenomenon rather than a one-off table or a routine small finite count.
